drafts.rationale: The A-series evidence defines one locus: how many executions a job may receive before further starts are forbidden, across wording and budget restatements.
drafts.subject: Job execution attempts

drafts.rationale: The B-series evidence specifies the fixed wait between a failed attempt and the next delivery, a distinct retry-timing locus.
drafts.subject: Job retry

drafts.rationale: The C-series evidence bounds how long a single execution may run and treats hitting that limit as failure, one timeout locus.
drafts.subject: Execution attempt

drafts.rationale: The D-series evidence requires ignoring further deliveries of an already-active job id without changing that job's state.
drafts.subject: Job delivery

drafts.rationale: The E-series evidence defines how long Orion remembers a producer idempotency key and when a later same-key delivery is treated as new.
drafts.subject: Idempotency key

drafts.rationale: The F-series evidence sets the lease length granted on delivery and the consequence of expiry without renewal or release.
drafts.subject: Worker lease

drafts.rationale: The G-series evidence specifies when a worker may renew a held lease and how a renewal extends that lease, distinct from initial duration.
drafts.subject: Worker lease

drafts.rationale: The H-series evidence states that cancellation forbids future attempts but does not interrupt an attempt already running.
drafts.subject: Job cancellation

drafts.rationale: The I-series evidence requires automatic dead-letter placement after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbids further execution unless resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Exhausted job

drafts.rationale: The J-series evidence defines when repeated tenant dead-letter events raise an operator escalation, including the measurement window.
drafts.subject: Dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: The K-series evidence limits FIFO execution order to jobs in the same partition and withholds any cross-partition order guarantee.
drafts.subject: Queue execution

drafts.rationale: The L-series evidence states how long job-state audit events must be kept and when they may be deleted.
drafts.subject: Audit events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 require that a job be executed at most three times in total, with the first execution counting as one of those three.
EV-O-A03 and EV-O-A04 allow one initial execution plus up to three retries, and EV-O-A04's example states the job is not executed a fifth time.
EV-O-B01 through EV-O-B04 require a wait of exactly five seconds after a failed attempt before every retry, independent of attempt number.
EV-O-C01 sets a thirty-second execution timeout; EV-O-C02, EV-O-C03, and EV-O-C04 restate the same limit as half a minute, after which the execution is stopped and recorded as failed.
EV-O-D01 through EV-O-D04 require duplicate deliveries of an active job id to be ignored without changing that job's state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, further deliveries with the same job id must be ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 through EV-O-E04 require each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which it may be forgotten.
EV-O-F01 through EV-O-F04 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery; on expiry without renewal or release the job becomes available to other workers.
EV-O-G01 through EV-O-G04 allow renewal every thirty seconds while work progresses and require each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from that moment.

value.text: A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work is progressing, and each renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 through EV-O-H04 forbid starting further attempts after cancellation while requiring an in-flight attempt to run to its own completion, failure, or timeout.

value.text: After cancellation, no future execution attempt may be started, but an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 through EV-O-I04 require an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt, with no further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, the job is automatically moved to the dead-letter queue and must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01 through EV-O-J04 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for one tenant within one hour measured from the first event.

value.text: Three dead-letter events for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of those events, must raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01 through EV-O-K04 guarantee first-in-first-out order only within a queue partition and make no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering is guaranteed between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 through EV-O-L04 require audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded and allow deletion thereafter.
